title: ProvenanceV0
description: Minimum source identity for a normalized knowledge fact, tracing it back to the wiki inventory snapshot it was derived from. Deliberately does not require character offsets or table cell coordinates (tools/wiki's inventory pipeline does not currently produce them). revision_id is present but optional so revision metadata can be attached later without a schema version bump.

snapshot_id.description: The knowledge/raw/fandom/<snapshot_id>/ acquisition snapshot this fact was derived from.

pageid.description: MediaWiki page id of the source page.

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the source page's wikitext content at acquisition time.

revision_id.description: Optional MediaWiki revision id, when available. Not required in v0 (tools/wiki/inventory.py's pages.jsonl does not currently retain it), but reserved so it can be populated later without changing this schema's required fields.

template_occurrence_index.description: 0-based index of the specific template invocation on the source page this fact came from, when the fact was derived from a template field.

table_index.description: 0-based index of the specific table on the source page this fact came from, when the fact was derived from a table.

section.description: Nearest enclosing section heading text on the source page, when relevant.
